about_the_game:
Mushroam is a 2D puzzle-platformer where you play a mushroom bubblemancer’s apprentice, on a journey through dangerous caves and ruins to save your village. You must use your powers to place bubbles that launch you through the air to avoid hazards and reach new depths!

You are the bubblemancer’s apprentice! Using your powers you can place and aim up to 2 bubbles at a time anywhere on the level. On contact, they will pop, launching you in their direction. These bubbles will be your superpower, and will help you avoid spikes, pits, sentries, and other hazards to reach the exit of each chamber!

Journey across 5 distinct depths of the underground. From the lush forest floor above, to the ruins of a subterranean city, and the abstract scars of an ancient kingdom! Each depth increases in challenge, but your power and knowledge must prevail!

Complete challenges in the game to unlock different mushfolk to play as on your adventure! From the steadfast Mush, to the dynamic Celia, or the loveable Bolo.

Each level is scored according to a number of challenges, such as beating a par time, not dying, or acquiring the level’s collectible. Challenge yourself to master the levels for the highest score!

  • OS: Window 10

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 970 (or equivalent)
